notes: SLAs now appear in the spell list. 0.7.0 only recognised spellbook spells, because the game treats a spell-like ability as a completely different kind of thing internally — so every enhancement-tree, destiny and action-boost ability was invisible. The scan is now built around the game's generic ability model instead, which covers spells and SLAs alike: each one shows with its icon, an 'SLA' tag so you can tell it apart from a same-named spell, and its real cooldown read straight from the ability itself. Friendly-targeted abilities are no longer guessed as heals unless they actually look like healing (Haste was being suggested as a heal). New 'Show all' checkbox lists every hotbar entry if something you want still isn't there, and the Unassigned group header shows how many entries were found.
